data.title: Tom Lee’s Ethereum Year-End Call Is Now Half Of What He Called ‘Conservative’ Last Month, But He Expects ‘Monster Moves’ In The Crypto Industry
data.description: Tom Lee tied the nearer call to BTC, saying ETH should reach about $7,500 if Bitcoin hits $100,000.
